change: Ringside Contact 5 moves from per-round pools to the match ledger ringside-match-1: one 30 s betting window before round 1, three match markets, no bets between rounds, every pool settled once when the bout ends. New arena UI from a Claude Design canvas.
engine: ringside-contact-5-dfd179bd (unchanged fight engine and learning rule)
ledger: ringside-match-1; realtime DO name ringside-match-v1 (not deployed; v5 was never deployed, local test storage only)
fairness: All three round seeds are drawn before the window opens; sha256('sollish:ringside-match-1:seed:<bout>:<n>:<seed>') hashes are published in every snapshot. Earlier rounds (seed, initial state, plan log) are published so a browser joining late replays the whole bout (verifyMatchHistory). Jev plans still arrive after cutoff: DEMO only.

marketDesign.source: ops/evidence/ringside-match-20261009/match-stats-300.json and a knockdown-count run on the same 300 seeds, fallback plans
marketDesign.rounds: 288 of 300 bouts go three rounds, 12 end in round 2
marketDesign.method: KOR stop 28, KOR points 95, AYAZ points 103, AYAZ stop 74
marketDesign.decision: A yes/no knockdown market resolved 'yes' in 96% of bouts, so it was replaced by the knockdown count (0-1 / 2 / 3+, about 40/39/21%). '3+' is stored as '3-plus' because pool outcome ids allow only [A-Za-z0-9._:-] (caught by the workerd settlement test).
